questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, why did the LORD say the east gate of the sanctuary must stay shut?

answers.text: The LORD God of Israel had entered through it
Its doors were never finished being built
Enemies once broke into the city through it

questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision, God said Israel defiled His temple by bringing which people in to occupy His sanctuary?

answers.text: Foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh
Soldiers sent by the king of Babylon

questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision of the new temple, what did the priests descended from Zadok do when Israel went astray from God?

answers.text: They kept charge of His sanctuary
They fled the land for Egypt
